I answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**.

That comes from Dana's message in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025, a channel Marcus is in. She wrote that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 on the morning shift. The same trailer showed up as two 06:30 check-ins, once from the kiosk and once when dispatch added it manually. I told him Dana owns the account and has the screenshots.

I also gave Thea's title, Director of Yard Operations, which I took from the North team cheat sheet in GBrain rather than from the channel. That sheet was written for Ruth, so Marcus may not have seen it. A contact's title counts as an operational fact, and Marcus is on the account's team, so it's fine for him to have it.

The account files folder came back empty when I looked, so I couldn't check the contact against a file.
